description: This file is a test client for the allocd (resource allocation daemon) component in the Android Cuttlefish project. It provides command-line options to create/destroy interfaces, request IDs, stop sessions, and shutdown the resource server by communicating via JSON messages over local sockets. The source code handles JSON request construction, socket communication, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: int main(int argc,char * argv[])
methods.description: Entry point of the program; parses command-line flags, establishes socket connection, performs actions such as creating/destroying interfaces, requesting IDs, stopping sessions, or shutting down the resource server based on flags.
